S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  14.06.2024 C482 No. 1061 of 2024  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Brief Holder for the State.

2. By the present C482 Application, the present applicants are challenging the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 8328 of 2023, State Vs. Vivek Kumar Tyagi, whereby the applicants have been charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 of IPC read with Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, arising out of First Information Report No. 0165 of 2022 lodged by the respondent/complainant on 30.03.2022.

2. Brief facts of the case are that the son of applicant Nos. 1 & 2 married with the respondent No. 2 on 27.11.2020 and the FIR was lodged with the allegations that the respondent is being harassed under the garb of demand of dowry.
3. It is also alleged that the stri dhan of the informant is with the applicants and they are not returning it.

It is also alleged that the husband of the respondent /complainant was suffering from a very serious disease which was not disclosed at the time of marriage and on 01.08.2021, a demand of Rs. 20,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty Lakh only) was made with this threatening that if such a demand is not fulfilled, they will remarry their son with someone else.
4.

Unfortunately, the husband of the respondent died on 19.09.2023, but before that on 31.01.2023 the charge sheet was filed and thereafter on an application moved by the applicants the further investigation was ordered and thereafter supplementary chargesheet was filed on 27.09.2023.

5. Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, learned counsel for the applicants, on instructions, submits that up till after the unfortunate incident, in which the respondent/ complainant's husband died, no one came forward for the purposes of mediation and therefore, he has requested that this Court may make efforts for their mediation.

sentences.text: 6. After taking into consideration the submissions as advanced by the learned counsel for the applicants and further taking into consideration that the applicants lost their son as well as the respondent /complainant has also lost her husband, efforts should be made for their amicable settlement.
7. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Brief Holder accepts notice for respondent No. 1.

8. Issue notice to respondent No. 2.
9.
Learned counsel for the applicants shall take steps to serve the respondent within a week, by registered post acknowledgment due, returnable within three weeks.
Learned counsel for the applicants shall also take steps to serve respondent No. 2 through the counsel, appearing in the trial Court.

10. List this matter on 16.07.2024.
and the respondent No. 2 shall either remain present through V.C. or in person for the purpose of mediation.

Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicant shall pay a sum of Rs. 15,000/- to the respondent as litigation expenses on the next date fixed.
12.

Till the next date of listing, further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 8328 of 2023, State Vs.
Vivek Kumar Tyagi, pending in the Court Chief Judicial Magistrate, District Haridwar, arising out of FIR No. 0165 of 2022, shall remain stayed.
